messages:
sara (PM): Quick thought - can we add a small 'key origin' trace in the console so customers can see where an API key/token came from (org, project, SA, created-via UI/CLI)? would help support and security reviews.
lee (Eng): +1 useful. main concerns: perf & leaks. we should avoid pulling PII into the UI.
sara (PM): agreed on redaction. ideal is a short breadcrumb: Org > Project > ServiceAccount > CreatedBy. also show TTL/lease info and last-seen region.
omar (Auth): we can't display raw tokens or raw claims. what we can do: surface derived fields (hashed id of issuer, org id, project id), and a link to audit logs for full context (requires perms).
jess (Design): mock sketch: tiny pill chips with tooltips, and a "View audit" link that opens the log drawer. non-blocking, sits on key detail page.
lee (Eng): backend plan: new endpoint GET /api/v1/auth/key-trace?key_id=xxx returns {trace: ["org:O123","proj:P45","sa:SA-9"], sampled_events_link: "..."} - must be cached. sampling helps with cost.
tay (SRE): agree sampling. let's default to 0.5% for high-volume orgs, 5% for small orgs. also add a circuit-breaker to avoid big fanout during incidents.
omar (Auth): sampling means users might not see the trace sometimes. we should show a computed "most-likely origin" from metadata even if trace events absent.
lee (Eng): implementation detail: we already have an index in auth-indexer; can derive trace without touching raw events for many keys. for edge-cases we link to logs.
lee (Eng): code example we can use in the service (pseudo):
```
GET /auth/key-trace?kid=K123
200 {
  "trace": ["org:O123","proj:P45","sa:SA-9"],
  "computed_origin": "proj:P45",
  "sampled_events_link": "/logs?filter=K123&sample=1"
}
```
sara (PM): UX ask: show a "sampled" badge when the trace came from sampled events and a tooltip explaining sampling rates. non-sampled traces get a green check.
jess (Design): will mock both states. prefer badge copy: "verified via audit" vs "inferred - sampled".
tay (SRE): telemetry: emit event auth.key_trace.request with tags {org, project_size_bucket, sample_rate}. ensure we don't log key material.
lee (Eng): security checklist: omar can help define exact fields allowed. also we need a feature flag: console.key_trace=true for staged rollout.
omar (Auth): approved fields: org_id (hashed?), project_id (hashed?), sa_display_name, creation_source (ui/cli/service), creation_ts (rounded to minute). no raw user email.
infra-bot: deploy queued: auth-trace-service v2 -> staging at 2026-03-22T03:12:00Z :truck: 
sara (PM): owner: lee. runway: prototype + design review next week. canary strategy: enable for 5 internal orgs, then 50 beta orgs.
lee (Eng): I'll open a PR and add the feature flag. also adding dashboards: error rate in key-trace fetches, and sampling coverage by org size.
omar (Auth): one more: for cross-org support tokens (delegation) show both origin and acting principal: "issued_for: proj:P, acted_by: SA-X". display both compactly.
jess (Design): good call - wire will show two-line breadcrumb when delegation present.
sara (PM): sweet. next step: lee files RFC + jira ticket, tag auth/console/design/sre.
lee (Eng): will do, dropping initial RFC link here when ready.
tay (SRE): +1. also put a guard in routing: if trace endpoint is slow, fallback to "inferred only" mode so console doesn't block.
sara (PM): thanks team :thumbsup:
